₹1 lakh to ₹25 lakh: 33 Indian stocks that rose 25x in 10 years

Stocks in today's Nifty 500 and Nifty Microcap 250 whose share price rose 25 times or more between 20 November 2016 and 20 November 2026. ₹1 lakh invested in each would now be worth ₹25 lakh or more (price change only, split and bonus adjusted, dividends not included).
